additional_pinned_primary_sources.finding: FileList dumps every entry with service.file_schema and expands item/transfer links identically to FileItem. Source read publicly; no claim of a local raw-byte hash.
Default item and list classes share FileSchema.

findings: Canonical owner is one object with string user. No source support for integer-owner/list-owner coercion.
Canonical first unreviewed version1 status is draft. Other source review/version statuses are legitimate generally, but incompatible with this test identity.
Files aggregates/entries can be omitted by serialization permission or missing attribute; omission is not proof of empty files. Actual reported beforeimage has all matching empty fields.
PID dictionary may be empty; identifier/provider strings are required when DOI exists; client is optional. No null/list PID coercion or provider/client fallback.

Modern application/json creation forwards parsed data. create uses raise_errors=False, so HTTP201 does not prove complete metadata persisted. No source proof of the deployed reason for absent metadata or a body-version mismatch.
update_draft also reports rather than raises validation errors. Require full exact expected metadata/access and no errors after PUT before any upload.

Current file-list validation already applies the same complete file predicate used by detail GET. Pinned source supports omitting the redundant detail read if actual list entry passes every unchanged predicate.

pure_fixed_field_diagnostic_contract.inputs: Decoded JSON plus private exact expected fixture/id/owner/create interval; no transport, writes or environment access.
pure_fixed_field_diagnostic_contract.outputs: Fixed known paths only, each with present boolean, closed-vocabulary type label, and independently computed match booleans. No values, arbitrary key names, links, timestamps, IDs, DOI strings, credentials, exception text or single adoption flag.
pure_fixed_field_diagnostic_contract.redaction: Bound raw body and decoded credential checks precede any persistence or diagnostic projection. Missing nested objects produce fixed false/type results rather than exceptions. bool is distinct from int.

remaining_blockers: Review concrete continuation implementation/grant/immutable evidence validation and mock tests before parent dispatch. This source review is not provider execution or a grant.

separate_continuation_contract.authority: Parent explicitly authorized preparing this exact verified owned empty draft; concrete frozen implementation and parent-dispatched bound grant still required.
separate_continuation_contract.binding: Separate exclusive controller/ledger pins original failed02 grant/state/journal/201 create intent and response hashes, canonical GET beforeimage/diagnostics hashes, exact private candidate ID/owner/parent/created, packet and runtimes. Original failed state, counters and old files remain byte-immutable.
separate_continuation_contract.clock: Preserve original private absolute expiry; any separately explicit parent continuation window must be a reviewed bounded mapping, never automatic extension. Enforce unchanged20s per-request wall and64KiB response bounds.
separate_continuation_contract.doi_preservation: If DOI is already present, persist and preserve exact PID through metadata PUT; never allocate a replacement. Current report says absent.
separate_continuation_contract.durability: Exact ID/parent/created and returned DOI durable before subsequent mutations. Consume and fsync every remaining action intent before transport; interruption/uncertain mutation permanently holds that continuation and cannot replay.
separate_continuation_contract.failure: Any partial/malformed/wrong-owner/identity/nonempty-beforeimage/metadata/access/PID/list-entry/content uncertainty stops before the next mutation; no fallback or blind relaxation.
separate_continuation_contract.identity_before_metadata: Validate exact sealed empty beforeimage and original create causal handle/time, first-draft identity, owner, links and complete empty files. This bounded empty-draft phase does not require missing initial metadata or already-correct access.files, and is not generic cached-ID adoption.
separate_continuation_contract.no_create: CREATE action/route absent and historical create permanently consumed; no failed-state reopening/reset/new namespace/new version/publish/delete.
separate_continuation_contract.readback: Three reads each pass: draft record; full file list exactly one entry validated using unchanged complete file predicate; exact content bytes. No detail GET fallback. Final plus unchanged retry spend6 further GETs,7 including diagnostic,<=8 lifetime.
separate_continuation_contract.transport: Use already reviewed ordinary Session.request route, opaque intended-auth equality, TLS/CA, zero redirect/retry/probe/constructor GET.
separate_continuation_contract.write_order: One metadata/access PUT first; immediately require complete exact updated payload/access/no errors with DOI absent permitted. Reserve DOI once only if still absent, then validate same updated draft identity and strict DOI before file init/content/commit.
